newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Citibank NZ half year profit eases slightly.
newsitem.headline: Citibank NZ half year profit eases slightly.

text.p: The New Zealand branch of Citibank N.A. on Tuesday reported a NZ$4.17 million net profit after tax and extraordinary items for the six months to June 30, down slightly from $4.64 million a year earlier.
The profit as a percentage of average total assets rose to 0.55 percent from 0.52 percent.
Total assets fell 28.25 percent to NZ$1.48 billion from $2.06 billion.
Total impaired assets fell to NZ$$3.22 million from $3.78 million. Citibank New Zealand operates as a branch of Citibank N.A, which is a unit of Citicorp.
